summary: Iter75 mobile frontend test of SHOPbakēd module context/branding/nav. Verified Tests A (MART→SHOP), B (SHOP→MART), and C (cross-module cart) at 420x900 viewport using preview URL. All three flows PASS. Module-aware bottom-nav (Home/Categories) resolves per activeModule, SHOP tint #FCC44C and MART tint #77BC1F confirmed via computed styles, Cart+Profile stay #77BC1F (global). AppSelectorSheet correctly shows m-app-selector-current-{mart|shop} badge in-sync with activeModule and swaps as the module switches. /shop/categories renders shopbaked-categories-index with 19 SHOP tiles (shopbaked-cat-mode-femme, -mode-homme, ...); zero MART leak (no m-cat-tile-* elements). /categories on MART side has no shopbaked leak. Deep-link path /shop/c/mode-femme → Home tap returns to /shop. Cross-module cart works: added MART product prd_76539… and SHOP product shpprd_7ff8… (via /shop/p/{id} → shopbaked-pdp-add-to-cart) — /cart shows BOTH lines with module chips (text 'MART' + 'SHOP').

testid_gaps.impact: Review request referenced cart-module-badge-{id}; mobile cart page uses m-cart-badge-{id}. Badges functionally render 'MART' and 'SHOP' labels correctly. Consider adding an alias data-testid or unifying naming for cross-viewport tests.

action_items: (Minor / optional) Align cart line module-badge testid to cart-module-badge-{id} to match review contract, OR update spec — current impl uses m-cart-badge-{id}. Functionality is correct, only naming differs.

(Seed) SHOP subcategory 'mode-femme/robes-femme' has zero products (shopbaked-category-empty). Iter74 test SHOP products exist under a different subcat (shpsub_5dc51fcb1eb84905). Not blocking iter75 but worth seeding at least one product under mode-femme for a fully realistic MART→SHOP→category→product journey.
critical_code_review_comments: MobileBottomNav.jsx cleanly resolves active module from useApp() and drives HOME/CATS route tables + tint via MODULES registry — a good pattern; consider hoisting HOME/CATS into /lib/modules.js so any future module addition is one-line.
MobileBottomNav Cart+Profile hardcode tint='#77BC1F' inline — comment already explains it's intentional (global). OK.
ShopCategoriesIndex.jsx: Good empty-state and loading/error handling. abs() helper duplicated across shop pages — could be centralized.
AppSelectorSheet.jsx: isCurrent border/badge logic is clean; ensure setActiveModule persists (context uses localStorage per prior iters) so refresh keeps the SHOP tint.
